title: Global Impact Cash Grants
place: Applications via Cisco's online grants portal
profileFit: Up to $75,000-$100,000 for nonprofits using tech for education/economic empowerment — Tech4Change's rural youth IT/AI training mission fits squarely.

title: USADF Grants for Community-Based Organizations
profileFit: USADF specifically funds African-owned/managed CBOs ($25,000-$250,000) — Tech4Change, as a Kenyan CBO, is a direct eligibility match.

title: AWDF Small Grants Programme
place: Kenya is one of AWDF's focus countries
profileFit: Grants ($1,000-$50,000) for women-led African organizations; as founder/leader of Tech4Change, Rotich fits AWDF's mandate.

title: Google.org Impact Challenge: AI for Government Innovation
profileFit: Large-scale ($1M-$3M+) funding for nonprofits/social enterprises using AI for public impact; relevant if Tech4Change partners with county government digital-skills initiatives.

title: GSMA Innovation Fund
place: Low- and middle-income countries incl. Kenya
profileFit: £100,000-£200,000 grants for mobile/digital-technology ventures advancing digital inclusion — aligned with Tech4Change's mission, best fit if it develops an earned-income digital product.

title: Africa Mradi Research Grants
profileFit: Mozilla's Africa-rooted innovation/research grantmaking — relevant if Tech4Change develops locally-grounded digital-inclusion research or tools.

title: Co-Impact Gender Fund
place: Kenya is a designated focus country
profileFit: Large, flexible, multi-year grants ($1M-$20M) for women-led, locally-rooted organizations in focus countries including Kenya — aspirational but on-mission for a growing Tech4Change.

title: Citi Foundation Global Innovation Challenge
profileFit: Funds NGOs integrating AI/digital-literacy tools into youth employability programs — a precise thematic match for Tech4Change's IT/AI training work.

title: Segal Family Foundation Grants
profileFit: Funds grassroots Sub-Saharan African organizations via trusted local referrals rather than open applications — worth building relationships with their Kenya partner network; not a direct-apply option.

title: Grants for Nonprofits
place: Applications via Comic Relief online portal
profileFit: Periodically opens youth digital-skills/AI-access funds for Sub-Saharan Africa; worth monitoring for calls matching Tech4Change's mission.

title: DataCamp Donates
profileFit: Free 1-year DataCamp access for qualifying nonprofits/coding-education organizations — Tech4Change could apply directly for free data-literacy curriculum for its rural youth trainees.

title: Tony Elumelu Foundation Entrepreneurship Programme
profileFit: $5,000 seed capital + 12-week business training for African entrepreneurs; relevant if she formalizes a tech-training social enterprise arm (requires a for-profit/early-stage business structure).

title: Wellcome Genomics in Context Awards
place: Any location (lead applicant, except mainland China)
profileFit: Up to £500,000 for collaborative genomics research; open to all career stages including early-career, directly on-theme for genetics.

title: IFS Individual Research Grant
profileFit: Up to US$15,000 for early-career researchers (within 5 years of independence) in agricultural/biological sciences — good fit post-PhD or post-Master's research.

title: TWAS Seed Grant for New African Principal Investigators (SG-NAPI)
profileFit: Supports African early-career PIs returning from PhD studies abroad (under 40), covering biology/agriculture/medical sciences.

title: Grand Challenges Africa
profileFit: Seed ($100K) and scale-up ($1M) grants for Africa-led scientific innovation, periodically covering genomics/health/agriculture themes.

title: DELTAS Africa II
provider: Science for Africa Foundation / Wellcome / FCDO
profileFit: $70M programme funding PhD/postdoc/senior fellowships across African consortia for health and biosciences research leadership.

title: Biodiversity Exploration and Discovery Grant
profileFit: Up to $50,000 for species discovery/distribution research — relevant to genetic diversity/biodiversity genomics fieldwork in Kenya.

title: Grand Challenges (Gates Foundation) Open RFPs
profileFit: Periodic calls often include genomics/sequencing and agricultural biotechnology themes relevant to global health and crop research.

title: IDRC Science Granting Councils Initiative
profileFit: Canadian-funded research grants supporting African science capacity including agriculture and bioinformatics/digital-technology streams relevant to agrigenomics.

title: Royal Society International Collaboration Awards
profileFit: Funds joint UK-Africa research collaborations addressing development challenges; a route into funded collaborative genomics/genetics research.

title: African Academy of Sciences — Research Programmes
profileFit: Umbrella portal for AAS's African-led biosciences/genomics funding programmes (ARISE, APTI, FLAIR, DELTAS) worth monitoring regularly — the old standalone AESA brand/page has been retired.

title: HELB Scholarships & Bursaries
profileFit: General Kenyan government study-loan and bursary body — not field-specific, but worth knowing about for either of you or for referring Tech4Change trainees.

title: Africa Digital Rights Fund (ADRF)
provider: CIPESA (Collaboration on International ICT Policy for East and Southern Africa)
deadline: No round currently open — recurs roughly annually, monitor official site for the next call
profileFit: CBO grant: confirmed Kenya-based CBOs/tech hubs are eligible; covers digital literacy and skills-building activities fitting Tech4Change's IT/AI training work. No round currently open — worth monitoring.

title: Technology and Society Program — Letter of Inquiry
opening: Grants ~$50,000-$500,000 via online Letter of Inquiry
deadline: Rolling — submit LOI anytime via Ford's grant inquiry portal
profileFit: CBO grant: funds civil-society capacity to use technology for public interest/equitable access — plausible fit for Tech4Change, though competitive and LOI-gated.

title: AI / Data-for-Good Grants
place: N/A (grants to nonprofits; evidenced grantees in Kenya/East Africa)
opening: Awards up to $125,000 plus hands-on technical partnership
deadline: Mostly invitation-only; occasional open calls — monitor site
profileFit: CBO grant: own grants database shows real East Africa AI/data-literacy grantees, but foundation does not accept unsolicited requests — best used as a relationship-building target rather than a direct open application.

title: Equitable Access Initiative — Women in the Digital Economy (Sub-Saharan Africa)
opening: $5M committed; funding from $1,000 to multi-million, median $250,000
deadline: Invitation-only per Visa Foundation's own portal
profileFit: CBO grant: explicitly Sub-Saharan Africa and digital-inclusion focused (strong thematic fit for a woman-led Tech4Change), but confirmed invite-only — flagged accordingly.

title: Humboldt Research Fellowship for Postdoctoral Researchers
deadline: Rolling admission; apply ahead of next selection round
profileFit: Self-chosen postdoctoral research stay in Germany, any field incl. genetics/genomics; official page explicitly states open to researchers of all nationalities (only excludes German nationals).

title: Postdoctoral Fellowships (Long-Term Fellowship)
place: Host institution in an HFSP member country
profileFit: 3-year interdisciplinary life-science postdoc; confirms applicants may be of any nationality (though the host lab must be in a member country, not Kenya itself).

title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
place: Host lab in an EMBC member/associate state
opening: Applications accepted on a rolling basis
profileFit: Up to 2-year molecular biology/genetics postdoc fellowship; eligibility is nationality-independent (requires a change of country, fitting a Kenya-to-abroad move).

title: AGNES-BAYER Science Foundation Research Grant 2026
provider: African-German Network of Excellence in Science (AGNES), funded by Bayer Foundation with Alexander von Humboldt Foundation
profileFit: EUR 7,000 grant for PhD students in biodiversity conservation/sustainable agriculture in sub-Saharan Africa — fits plant/agricultural genetics fieldwork; explicitly requires sub-Saharan African nationality, so Kenya qualifies directly.

title: Research Development Fellowship (RDF)
place: Placement at a UK, European, or African host institution; home base in Africa
opening: Next cycle (2027/28) expected to open early 2027
profileFit: Up to GBP 47,000 for early-career African postdoctoral researchers/clinicians on human health challenges; explicitly requires African nationality and employment at an African institution.

title: Early-Career Research Fellowships
provider: African Research Universities Alliance (ARUA) / Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities
profileFit: PhD completed within 5 years, applicant under 35; explicitly requires African nationality; covers natural-science Centres of Excellence relevant to genomics/health/food systems.

title: African Research Initiative for Scientific Excellence (ARISE)
provider: African Academy of Sciences (AAS), with African Union and European Union support
place: Based at an African university or research institution
opening: No open call currently — check site for next cohort
profileFit: Up to EUR 500,000 over 5 years for mid-career African researchers (2-7 years post-PhD) to lead their own research programme; explicitly requires African nationality and an African host institution.
